title: Yellow Dense Chinese Tofu Bao
description: A spicy and dense Chinese dish from Jiangsu, featuring creme fraiche and a cure, made satvik-friendly and served in a bamboo tray.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, szechuan pepper, and salt to make the cure.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the cure.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a steamer basket with a bamboo tray inside.
Add the marinated tofu to the steamer basket, leaving some space between each cube.
Steam the tofu for 10 minutes, or until it is cooked through and dense.
While the tofu is steaming, mix the creme fraiche with chopped scallions and sliced bamboo shoots in a small bowl.
Once the tofu is done, let it cool for a few minutes before serving with the creme fraiche mixture spooned over the top.
Serve the Yellow Dense Chinese Tofu Bao in the bamboo tray, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
